name: Ghamoo-ra
summary: Ghamoo-ra is an ancient, giant sea turtle inhabiting the Pool of Ask'ar within Blackfathom Deeps, the sunken temple of Elune now overrun by the Twilight's Hammer cult. Armored in a massive shell, he savagely tramples any intruders who approach his island.

sections.title: A Beast of the Drowned Temple
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps was once a night elven temple dedicated to Elune, now flooded and claimed by naga, satyr and the nihilistic Twilight's Hammer cult. Ghamoo-ra dwells among its drowned ruins, an enormous turtle whose thick shell turns aside all but the most determined blows.

sections.title: Guardian of the Deeps
sections.body: Ghamoo-ra roams a small island in the Pool of Ask'ar, surrounded by lesser turtles that leave travelers be. He alone attacks, crushing any who come near beneath his trampling bulk.

faq.answer: Ghamoo-ra is a giant turtle found in the Pool of Ask'ar within Blackfathom Deeps, the flooded temple of Elune now held by the Twilight's Hammer. He attacks anyone who approaches his island.

faq.q: Why is Ghamoo-ra hostile to outsiders?
faq.answer: Nothing is recorded of how he came to be so savage. He simply attacks anyone who intrudes on his island in the Pool of Ask'ar, trampling all who come near.
Yes. Despite his size and years of torment, Ghamoo-ra can be tamed by a skilled hunter.

faq.q: What is the Pool of Ask'ar?
faq.answer: The Pool of Ask'ar is a flooded subterranean cavern in Blackfathom Deeps. Ghamoo-ra roams the center of a small island there, encircled by docile native turtles.

faq.q: What connection does he have to the Old Gods?
faq.answer: None is recorded. Ghamoo-ra is a beast of the deep, though the Twilight's Hammer cultists who worship the Old Gods have overrun the sunken temple around him.

angles.text: Hunters venturing into Blackfathom Deeps may pity Ghamoo-ra, a noble, ancient beast of the deep, though a patient hunter may yet tame him.
For night elves, Ghamoo-ra's savage presence in Elune's drowned temple is a bitter reminder of how far the sacred site has fallen to the vile Twilight's Hammer.
Druids find in Ghamoo-ra an ancient creature of the deep, grown savage amid the ruins of the defiled temple.
